```{ojs}
fiMu0 = 0
fiDelta = 0.5
fiN = fiControls.n
fiSigma = fiControls.sigma
fiSe = fiSigma / Math.sqrt(fiN)
fiInformation = fiN / fiSigma ** 2
fiReciprocalInformation = 1 / fiInformation

fiNormalPdf = (x, mean, sd) =>
  Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mean) / sd) ** 2) /
  (sd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI))

fiErf = x => {
  const sign = x < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  const value = Math.abs(x);
  const t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * value);
  const polynomial = (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t) +
    1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t;
  return sign * (1 - polynomial * Math.exp(-value * value));
}

fiNormalCdf = x => 0.5 * (1 + fiErf(x / Math.sqrt(2)))
fiOverlap = 2 * fiNormalCdf(-Math.abs(fiDelta) / (2 * fiSe))

fiDensityDomain = [
  fiMu0 - 4.25 * fiSe,
  fiMu0 + fiDelta + 4.25 * fiSe
]

fiDensityData = d3.range(401).map(index => {
  const x = fiDensityDomain[0] + index *
    (fiDensityDomain[1] - fiDensityDomain[0]) / 400;
  const trueDensity = fiNormalPdf(x, fiMu0, fiSe);
  const nearbyDensity = fiNormalPdf(x, fiMu0 + fiDelta, fiSe);
  return {
    x,
    trueDensity,
    nearbyDensity,
    overlapDensity: Math.min(trueDensity, nearbyDensity)
  };
})

fiDensityYMax = d3.max(fiDensityData, point =>
  Math.max(point.trueDensity, point.nearbyDensity)
)

fiLikelihoodDomain = [-1.5, 1.5]
fiExpectedLogLikelihood = d3.range(501).map(index => {
  const mu = fiLikelihoodDomain[0] + index *
    (fiLikelihoodDomain[1] - fiLikelihoodDomain[0]) / 500;
  return {
    mu,
    relativeLogLikelihood: -0.5 * fiInformation * (mu - fiMu0) ** 2
  };
}).filter(point => point.relativeLogLikelihood >= -12)
```

```{ojs}
fiDistinguishabilityPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 330,
  marginLeft: 58,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Possible sample mean x̄", domain: fiDensityDomain},
  y: {label: "Density", domain: [0, 1.12 * fiDensityYMax], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(fiDensityData, {
      x: "x",
      y: "overlapDensity",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-5)"
    }),
    Plot.line(fiDensityData, {
      x: "x",
      y: "trueDensity",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2.7
    }),
    Plot.line(fiDensityData, {
      x: "x",
      y: "nearbyDensity",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2.7,
      strokeDasharray: "6,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([fiMu0], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 1.7
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([fiMu0 + fiDelta], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 1.7,
      strokeDasharray: "6,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"})
  ]
})

fiCurvaturePlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 330,
  marginLeft: 62,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Candidate mean μ", domain: fiLikelihoodDomain, grid: true},
  y: {
    label: "Expected log-likelihood relative to maximum",
    domain: [-12, 0.6],
    grid: true
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(fiExpectedLogLikelihood, {
      x: "mu",
      y1: "relativeLogLikelihood",
      y2: 0,
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-1)"
    }),
    Plot.line(fiExpectedLogLikelihood, {
      x: "mu",
      y: "relativeLogLikelihood",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2.8
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([fiMu0], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
fiReadout = md`${tex`\mathcal I_n(\mu)=\frac{n}{\sigma^2}=${fiInformation.toFixed(3)};\qquad
  \frac{1}{\mathcal I_n(\mu)}=\frac{\sigma^2}{n}=${fiReciprocalInformation.toFixed(3)};\qquad
  \operatorname{overlap}=${fiOverlap.toFixed(3)}`}`

html`<div class="fi-figure-shell ojs-figure-shell">
  <div class="fi-plots ojs-plot-grid">
    <div class="fi-plot-panel ojs-plot-panel">
      <strong>Can two nearby means be told apart?</strong>
      ${fiDistinguishabilityPlot}
    </div>
    <div class="fi-plot-panel ojs-plot-panel">
      <strong>How sharply does expected log-likelihood peak?</strong>
      ${fiCurvaturePlot}
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="fi-legend" aria-label="Plot legend">
    <span><i class="fi-true"></i> ${tex`\bar X\mid\mu=0`}</span>
    <span><i class="fi-nearby"></i> ${tex`\bar X\mid\mu=0.5`}</span>
    <span><i class="fi-overlap"></i> Shared probability area</span>
    <span><i class="fi-reference"></i> True mean</span>
  </div>

  <div class="fi-readout" role="status" aria-live="polite">${fiReadout}</div>
</div>

<style>
  .fi-legend {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: .55rem 1.1rem;
    margin: .65rem 0;
    font-size: .88rem;
  }
  .fi-legend > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
  .fi-true { width: 1.25rem; border-top: 3px solid var(--plot-series-1); display: inline-block; }
  .fi-nearby { width: 1.25rem; border-top: 3px dashed var(--plot-series-4); display: inline-block; }
  .fi-overlap { width: 1rem; height: .72rem; background: var(--plot-fill-5); border: 1px solid var(--plot-series-5); display: inline-block; }
  .fi-reference { width: 1.25rem; border-top: 2px dashed var(--plot-reference); display: inline-block; }
  .fi-readout {
    margin: .65rem 0 0;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: .9rem;
  }
  .fi-readout > p { margin: 0; }
</style>`
```

```{ojs}
// Keep the controls mounted beneath the reactive figure.
viewof fiControls = {
  const sampleForm = Inputs.form({
    n: Inputs.range([1, 100], {
      value: 10,
      step: 1,
      label: md`Sample size ${tex`n`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const noiseForm = Inputs.form({
    sigma: Inputs.range([0.5, 3], {
      value: 1.5,
      step: 0.1,
      label: md`Known standard deviation ${tex`\sigma`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Information controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Sample</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Observation noise</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  const columns = root.querySelectorAll(".controls-col");
  columns[0].append(sampleForm);
  columns[1].append(noiseForm);

  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get: () => ({...sampleForm.value, ...noiseForm.value})
  });

  return root;
}
```
